key_insight: OpenPVMapper combines multiple complementary data sources to build the first open, nationwide installation-level database of rooftop PV systems in mainland France.
engineering_relevance: The database can support grid planning, solar forecasting, asset monitoring, and policy analysis by providing large-scale, source-traceable rooftop PV locations and capacities.
method: Ran a deep-learning detector on nationwide aerial imagery
Merged detections with OpenStreetMap and a probabilistic building-level dataset
Tracked provenance, detection method, and manual validation flags for each installation
evidence_signal: The final database contains 1,135,850 installations totaling about 15.01 GWp, and a stratified manual review of 1,862 installations estimates overall precision at roughly 74–75% with gains from cross-source corroboration.
watch_item: Coverage and precision depend on source quality and reconciliation rules, so some installations may still be missed or misclassified despite multi-source aggregation.
paper_title: OpenPVMapper: A Multi-source, Nationwide Database of Rooftop Photovoltaic Systems in France
